# ============================================================================
# FCP_DCC ROLE-BASED PERMISSION MODEL \(Added 2026-02-19\)
# ============================================================================
# This section defines four user roles for the Food Control Plan Compliance
# Documentation system:
#   - data_recorder: Staff submitting forms \(chef, waitstaff\)
#   - data_editor: Managers who can fix form data errors
#   - inspector: Food safety inspectors \(read-only + talk pages\)
#   - editor-in-chief: System administrator \(inherits sysop\)
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DEFAULT: Deny all permissions to anonymous and basic users
# ============================================================================
$wgGroupPermissions['*']['edit'] = false;           # Anonymous cannot edit
$wgGroupPermissions['*']['createpage'] = false;     # Anonymous cannot create
$wgGroupPermissions['user']['move'] = false;        # Regular users cannot move
$wgGroupPermissions['user']['delete'] = false;      # Regular users cannot delete

# ============================================================================
# DATA_RECORDER Role: Kitchen Staff, Servers, Data Entry Staff
# ============================================================================
# Permissions: Can read pages, submit forms, edit their own form submissions
# Cannot: Delete pages, move pages, edit locked forms, edit system pages
# ============================================================================
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['read'] = true;
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['edit'] = true;           # Can edit unlocked pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['createpage'] = true;     # Can create form pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['createtalk'] = true;     # Can create talk pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['upload'] = true;         # Can upload attachments
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['reupload'] = true;       # Can replace files
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['delete'] = false;        # CANNOT delete
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['move'] = false;          # CANNOT move pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['protect'] = false;       # CANNOT protect pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_recorder']['editprotected'] = false; # CANNOT edit protected pages

# ============================================================================
# DATA_EDITOR Role: Managers, Supervisors
# ============================================================================
# Permissions: All data_recorder permissions PLUS:
#   - Can edit LOCKED forms \(to fix errors\)
#   - Can approve and lock forms
#   - Can unlock forms for correction
# Cannot: Delete pages, move pages, edit system pages \(templates, properties\)
# ============================================================================
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['read'] = true;
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['edit'] = true;              # Can edit all pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['createpage'] = true;        # Can create pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['createtalk'] = true;        # Can create talk pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['upload'] = true;            # Can upload files
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['reupload'] = true;          # Can replace files
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['editprotected'] = true;     # KEY: Can edit LOCKED pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['delete'] = false;           # CANNOT delete
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['move'] = false;             # CANNOT move pages
$wgGroupPermissions['data_editor']['protect'] = false;          # CANNOT protect pages

# ============================================================================
# INSPECTOR Role: Food Safety Inspectors, Health Inspectors
# ============================================================================
# Permissions: Can read all pages, add comments on talk pages
# Cannot: Edit form data \(read-only\), delete, move, protect pages
# Purpose: Review compliance documentation, ask questions, verify data
#          All interaction through talk page discussions \(separate from data\)
# ============================================================================
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['read'] = true;                # Can READ all pages
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['edit'] = false;               # CANNOT edit pages
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['createpage'] = false;         # CANNOT create pages
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['upload'] = false;             # CANNOT upload
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['delete'] = false;             # CANNOT delete
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['move'] = false;               # CANNOT move
$wgGroupPermissions['inspector']['protect'] = false;            # CANNOT protect
# NOTE: Inspector CAN edit talk pages - configured via page protection instead

# ============================================================================
# SYSOP \(editor-in-chief\): Owner/System Administrator
# ============================================================================
# Note: SYSOP group already has all permissions defined in MediaWiki core.
# No changes needed - sysop is all-powerful by default.
# The owner is automatically added to the 'sysop' group.
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# NAMESPACE PROTECTION: System Pages \(Admin Only\)
# ============================================================================
# Protects critical system infrastructure from accidental modification
# by non-admin users. Only sysop can edit templates, properties, and forms.
# ============================================================================

# Template namespace \(10\): Read-only for non-sysop
$wgNamespaceProtection[10] = array\( 'edit' => 'sysop' \);

# Property namespace \(102\): Read-only for non-sysop \(Semantic MediaWiki\)
$wgNamespaceProtection[102] = array\( 'edit' => 'sysop' \);

# Form namespace \(106\): Read-only for non-sysop \(Page Forms\)
$wgNamespaceProtection[106] = array\( 'edit' => 'sysop' \);

# ============================================================================
# PROTECTION LEVELS: Configure what protection means
# ============================================================================
# Maps protection levels to required permissions
# Used when protecting pages with Special:ProtectPage
# ============================================================================
$wgRestrictionLevels = [
	'',             # '' \(empty\) = no protection
	'autoconfirmed', # Requires autoconfirmed \(established\) users
	'sysop',        # Requires sysop/admin
];

$wgRestrictionTypes = [ 'edit', 'move' ];

# ============================================================================
